name: shm-k2-superior-inserters-full-hand-switcher
title: Krastorio2: Superior Inserters Full Hand Switcher
author: Shahimat
description: Krastorio 2 superior inserters wait for a full hand before dropping, like stack inserters. Each inserter can be switched back to dropping right away with SHIFT + M or a switch next to its window. K2 Spaced Out and Change Inserter Drop Lane compatible.
